title: 整合模組化航電概念
summary: 以「用時間、記憶體與介面隔離理解整合模組化航電」為主線，在航電分區排程與訊息流模型中依序完成分區時間預算、跨分區訊息量、感測到顯示的依賴鏈、分區和通訊故障組合、軟體裝載版本相容性及專題交接。十單元各含機制、定量、驗證和診斷，全部算例明示為教學假設；比較情境由學員依模型建構，不是現場量測資料。
summaryEn: Follow Understand integrated modular avionics through time, memory and interface separation in a Avionics partition schedule and message-flow model, progressing through Partition time budgets, Interpartition message traffic, Sensor-to-display dependency chain, Partition and communication fault combinations, Compatibility of software-load versions, then a course handoff. Ten units each cover mechanisms, calculation, verification and diagnosis. All numbers are explicit teaching assumptions; learners construct scenario comparisons from the models, not field measurements.
scope: 公開原理支持的原創航空教學。每個數值均明示為假設模型，非同名機型實際性能、維修手冊、製造工藝、取證判據或飛行操作。任務在模型完成，不提供武器、軍用性能最佳化或真機操作指示。
scopeEn: Original aviation teaching based on public principles. Every numerical example is an explicit hypothetical model, not named-aircraft performance, maintenance data, manufacturing process, certification criterion or flight operation. Tasks run in models, excluding weapons, military-performance optimization and aircraft operating instructions.

steps.objective: 辨識 分區時間預算 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。

steps.instruction: 在「整合模組化航電概念」中，本單元處理「分區時間預算」。各分區執行時間除週期的利用率相加可作第一輪負載檢查；排程可行性還取決於期限與阻塞。
steps.instructionEn: Within Integrated modular avionics concepts, this unit examines Partition time budgets. Summed execution-time/period utilization is a first load check; schedulability also depends on deadlines and blocking.
steps.observation: 本單元為獨立假想台架，與其他單元尺寸及負載不可直接拼接。原創教學假設，非機型實測或操作值：任務A每20 ms用3 ms；B每50 ms用8 ms。關係式 U=C1/T1+C2/T2；含輸出單位換算的算式 3/20+8/50，結果 0.31 utilization。適用範圍：固定週期與執行時間教學模型；U小於1不是充分的安全證明。
steps.observationEn: This unit uses an independent hypothetical bench; dimensions and loads must not be combined with other units without reconciliation. Original teaching assumptions, not aircraft measurements or operating settings: Task A uses 3 ms every 20 ms; B uses 8 ms every 50 ms. Relation U=C1/T1+C2/T2; evaluated expression including output-unit conversion 3/20+8/50 gives 0.31 utilization. Applicability: Fixed-period execution-time exercise; U below one is not a sufficient safety proof.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「整合模組化航電概念」的「分區時間預算：機制與觀察」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出機體、能源、感測、控制與地面驗證的介面，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「座艙模擬器：回應之前」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與試件構型、質量或負載表、原始量測與需求版本的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Partition time budgets: Mechanism and observation” in “Integrated modular avionics concepts”. Draw the airframe, energy, sensing, control and ground-verification interfaces; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Cockpit Simulator: Before the Response” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for specimen configuration, mass/load manifest, raw measurements and requirement version, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

steps.objective: 辨識 模式切換的記憶體峰值 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Memory peaks during mode changes and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 在「整合模組化航電概念」中，本單元處理「模式切換的記憶體峰值」。記憶體預算需把固定資料、緩衝和保留容量分開，並檢查最壞同時使用狀態。
steps.instructionEn: Within Integrated modular avionics concepts, this unit examines Memory peaks during mode changes. Separate fixed data, buffers and reserve and examine worst simultaneous use.
steps.observation: 本單元為獨立假想台架，與其他單元尺寸及負載不可直接拼接。原創教學假設，非機型實測或操作值：總容量M=64 MiB、固定資料F=20 MiB、緩衝B=28 MiB。關係式 reserve=M-F-B；含輸出單位換算的算式 64-20-28，結果 16 MiB。適用範圍：只計配置容量，不代表記憶體隔離或故障包容已驗證。
steps.observationEn: This unit uses an independent hypothetical bench; dimensions and loads must not be combined with other units without reconciliation. Original teaching assumptions, not aircraft measurements or operating settings: Total M=64 MiB, fixed data F=20 MiB and buffers B=28 MiB. Relation reserve=M-F-B; evaluated expression including output-unit conversion 64-20-28 gives 16 MiB. Applicability: Allocation budget only; memory isolation and fault containment are not established.
steps.failure: 在「模式切換的記憶體峰值」的情境中，記憶體洩漏可能在短測試不明顯，需比對多輪任務後基線。
steps.failureEn: In the context of Memory peaks during mode changes, A leak may escape short tests; compare baseline after repeated cycles.
steps.check: 針對「模式切換的記憶體峰值」，列出生命週期重疊的緩衝區，對切換模式的最高峰做模擬。 保留單位、條件及原始計算，並以另一種可能原因作對照。
